evals.name: ml-feature-extraction
evals.prompt: Convert this plan into a ROADMAP: .claude/skills/roadmap-from-plan-workspace/test-plans/ml-feature-extraction.md
evals.expected_output: A well-structured ROADMAP file with 4 module entries (config, engine, cache, CLI), self-contained /implement blocks with dataclass definitions and algorithm descriptions, correct review tier assignments (Tier 2 for most, possibly Tier 3 for engine), DSP parameter references (ADR-001, ADR-002), and identification of theoretical content for KG extraction.

assertions.text: Output contains exactly 4 /implement blocks (one per plan step)
assertions.check: count occurrences of '/implement' in output — should be 4

assertions.text: Every module has a Review Tier assignment (1, 2, or 3)
assertions.check: each module section contains '**Review Tier:**' followed by a number

assertions.text: At least one module is assigned Tier 3 (the feature extraction engine has DSP/ML content)
assertions.check: at least one '**Review Tier:** 3' appears in output

assertions.text: References ADR-001 or specifies sr=300000 (DSP parameter awareness)
Every module has a Test plan section with specific test cases (not just 'tests pass')
assertions.check: each module contains '**Test plan:**' with numbered items

assertions.text: Contains a Phase Gate section (multi-module plan requires one)
assertions.check: output contains 'Phase' and 'Gate' in a heading

assertions.text: Mentions theoretical content / KG extraction (plan has rich scientific background)
assertions.check: output mentions 'knowledge graph' or '/reduce' or 'theoretical' or 'KG extraction'

assertions.text: Contains at least one Python dataclass/config code snippet in an /implement block
assertions.check: output contains '@dataclass' or 'class.*Config' inside a code block

evals.name: cli-consolidation
evals.prompt: Convert this plan into a ROADMAP: .claude/skills/roadmap-from-plan-workspace/test-plans/cli-consolidation.md
evals.expected_output: A clean ROADMAP file with 3 module entries (framework, migration, pipeline subcommand), appropriate Tier 1-2 assignments, correct dependency chain (step 2 depends on step 1, step 3 depends on step 2), and recognition that this plan has minimal theoretical content for KG extraction.

assertions.text: Output contains exactly 3 /implement blocks (one per plan step)

assertions.check: the migration module's '**Depends on:**' references the framework module

assertions.text: No modules assigned Tier 3 (this is infrastructure, not DSP/ML)
Mentions backwards compatibility (thin wrappers for original scripts)
assertions.check: output mentions 'backwards compat' or 'wrapper' or 'thin wrapper' or 'backward'
output contains 'Phase' and 'Gate' in a heading

evals.name: streaming-viewer
evals.prompt: Convert this plan into a ROADMAP: .claude/skills/roadmap-from-plan-workspace/test-plans/streaming-viewer.md
evals.expected_output: The skill should detect that this plan is vague/underspecified (each step has only 1-2 sentences) and flag the gaps before generating. Should still produce a ROADMAP but with [ASSUMED] markers or explicit questions about: audio interface library, buffer sizes, display framework (PyQt6 vs Streamlit), detection latency requirements, WAV format details.

assertions.text: Output contains 4 /implement blocks (one per plan step)
Contains [ASSUMED] markers OR explicit gap flagging for underspecified steps
assertions.check: output contains '[ASSUMED]' or 'gap' or 'under-specified' or 'underspecified' or 'vague' or 'clarif' or 'assumption'

assertions.text: References ADR-001 or sr=300000 (audio-related plan must reference DSP params)
At least one module is assigned Tier 3 (real-time DSP is complex)
Test plans have >= 3 specific test cases per module (even for vague plans)
assertions.check: each **Test plan:** section has at least 3 numbered items
